name: protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit Balpha

function.text: PPP2R2A encodes serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2A 55 kDa regulatory subunit B alpha isoform. Annotated molecular activities include enzyme-substrate adaptor activity and protein phosphatase regulator activity. It participates in protein dephosphorylation and regulation of chromosome segregation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
